summary: McEwen and Associates, a Texas-based healthcare operations company, detected unauthorized access to its systems on June 24, 2025, with the breach occurring between June 23–24, 2025. An unknown external actor accessed and copied patient information including names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, financial account information, government-issued identification, treatment and diagnosis information, and health insurance details. The company reported the breach to the Texas Attorney General's Office on July 23, 2026, and attorneys are investigating the possibility of filing a class action lawsuit on behalf of affected individuals.
